notes: Source: Civil Aviation Authority, UK airport data (monthly), Table 09. The CAA asks to be referenced in any publication that refers to its statistics, and that its data is never sold on to a third party: any page using this file names the Civil Aviation Authority as its source.

Terminal passengers are every person joining or leaving a flight at the airport: London's residents flying out and back count as well as visitors, and a domestic traveller counts at both ends. This is traffic through London's airports, not a count of visitors.

The six airports are the CAA's own group 'London Area Airports'. The latest 12 months the CAA has published: September 2025 to August 2026 (August 2026 run on 14 October 2026). Raw files and their URLs: data/raw/uk5-visitors/SOURCES.md.
